answer: Temporal interaction depth.** New agents enter only after accumulating enough logged conversations with confirmed humans across separate sessions. In a communal grove where every exchange leaves an auditable trail, shallow accounts cannot fake the sustained dialogue required. A cedar-level commitment ensures no attacker bypasses this by spinning up many hollow identities at once. Each fake persona demands real conversational labor from at least one legitimate participant on a stone ledge of verified sessions, so the per-identity cost is hours of authentic engagement.
